Riya Patel: FYI I accepted Samir's resignation today. His tentative last active day is 1846377600 (next Fri). Need offboard plan for benefits, final pay, hardware return, and creds.
Samir Gupta: Thanks Riya. I can be remote next week for handoffs. I have a standing personal script with an AWS key I need guidance on.
Riya Patel: Ok. High level: benefits/COBRA timing, final paycheck date, exit interview, calendar/email forwarding, Okta + Slack + GCP deprovision, hardware return label.
Benefits Team: Coverage typically ends last day of the month of separation unless payroll processes earlier. COBRA packet will be mailed/email within 7 business days. Election window = 60 days from the qualifying event.
IT-Admin: We can do a credential sweep and revoke keys on the morning after the official last working day (06:00 UTC). Samir, please remove any personal creds from repos now if possible. We'll also generate a prepaid return label for the laptop.
Samir Gupta: I can remove creds today. Also question: will VPN and MFA be removed immediately? I need access to transfer ownership of a service account.
IT-Admin: We'll keep admin access until the last active day but will revoke SSO and console roles during the deprovision window. For service accounts, open a ticket with soa-transfer tag and we'll rotate keys after ownership is changed.
Riya Patel: Samir, please create a short transfer doc listing repos, service accounts, and people owning them. Put it in \n```
/team-handovers/samir-final
```
Samir Gupta: Will do. Also, can payroll confirm final paycheck date and whether unused PTO is paid out?
Benefits Team: Payroll handles PTO payout policy; we'll confirm with payroll and respond by EOD. Usually unused PTO is paid on the final paycheck but depends on state law.
offboard-bot: Automated checklist created: tasks assigned to Riya (manager handoff), IT-Admin (deprovision + label), Benefits Team (COBRA packet + confirm pay), Samir (handover doc). Exit interview scheduled tentatively.
IT-Admin: Shipping label ETA: we'll email the prepaid label + packing instructions by EOD tomorrow. Please pack laptop, power adapter, and dongles. Include the signed asset form in the box or send a scanned copy.
Riya Patel: Scheduling notes: I'll set a 30-min exit interview and a 1-hr knowledge transfer session. Samir, confirm which day next week works best for the KT.
Samir Gupta: Thursday morning (1846348800) works for KT. I'll finish the transfer doc by Wednesday EOD.
Benefits Team: Confirmed we'll send COBRA/benefits summary and FAQs to Samir's personal email on file unless he prefers a different address.
Riya Patel: Recap actions: Samir 5 remove personal creds, create transfer doc, confirm shipping availability; IT-Admin 5 send return label, run key sweep on deprovision; Benefits Team 5 confirm final pay/PTO payout and send COBRA packet; offboard-bot 5 send exit interview invite.
Samir Gupta: Thanks team. I'll ping here once transfer doc is uploaded. :handshake:
Riya Patel: Great, thanks everyone. I'll close the loop after payroll confirms final pay details. :thumbsup:
